title: Frequency; infants; Cap.15 next on the ministry of the word
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): CHAPTER FIFTEEN follows, On ye ministry belonging toward ye word. — As for little ones: since this mystery requires self-examination and announcing ye Lord's death (1 Cor. 11), ye institution does not belonging toward itself pertain toward infants who cannot perform these. — 13. True Christians do not use ye sacred Supper by custom alone, but eagerly and religiously from ardent desire for Christ, that they may satisfy His precept, enjoy His love and treasure, and frequently also for their own need, toward strengthen weak faith. In ye primitive church ye faithful communicated daily; later, as faith's ardor cooled, that custom faded.
pass_b_english: 13. True Christians do not use the sacred Supper by custom alone, but eagerly and religiously from ardent desire for Christ, that they may satisfy His precept, enjoy His love and treasure, and frequently also for their own need, to strengthen weak faith. In the primitive church the faithful communicated daily; later, as faith's ardor cooled, that custom faded.
As for little ones: since this mystery requires self-examination and announcing the Lord's death (1 Cor. 11), the institution does not of itself pertain to infants who cannot perform these.
CHAPTER FIFTEEN follows, On the ministry of the word.
source_text: 13. Veri Christiani non pro more & propter consuetudinem usurpant sacram coenam, sed ex ardenti Christi desiderio alacriter ac religiose, ut praecepto ipsius satisfaciant, dilectione & thesauro fruantur, tum ob suam etiam necessitatem frequenter, ut infirmam fidem roborent. In primitiva ecclesia fideles quotidie communicabant (Acts; Cyprian; Augustine); postmodum deminuto fidei ardore mos ille obsolvit. De parvulis: cum ad hoc mysterium requiratur sui probatio & mortis Domini annunciatio (1 Cor. 11), institutio huius sacramenti non per se pertinet ad parvulos qui haec praestare nequeunt. CAPUT DECIMUM QUINTUM sequitur, De ministerio verbi.
